feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 26 October 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 26 October 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales, risk of severe gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

A very deep area of low pressure will track north of Scotland, sweeping associated frontal systems across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South 6 or 7, increasing 7 or gale 8 this evening, then occasionally severe gale 9 in places early tonight. Veering Southwest 7 or gale 8 later in night, decreasing West or Southwest 6 or 7 later tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, building rough or very rough for a time tonight and at first tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain for a time tonight, isolated showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good at first, occasionally poor. Becoming generally good later tonight


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Southwest 6 or 7, decreasing 5 or 6 on Wednesday morning, 4 or 5 in afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.
